authority: Canonical machine-readable execution service objective and bounded-tranche timing policy.

continue_semantics.ordinary_bare_continue: Execute the selected bounded unit through validation, merge, completed_verified closeout and strict successor selection unless a genuine blocker prevents completion.

before_product_branch_creation: supply fresh authorized branch plus observed branch/open-PR snapshot
resume the exact authorized branch/open PR when present; never create an alternate duplicate attempt
execution_hardening.validation_evidence_rule: Only evidence whose validated head equals the current candidate head counts toward merge or closeout; superseded heads are non-counting without needing another broad discovery pass.
execution_hardening.closeout_precompute_rule: During current-head validation, precompute all closeout/successor projections that do not depend on final evidence. Leave validated head, run, deterministic receipt and merge SHA empty until observed.
execution_hardening.terminal_outcome_rule: For governed execution units completed after MV-CONT-010, owner_continue_turns=1 requires single_continue_achieved=true and execution_incident=null. More than one owner Continue requires single_continue_achieved=false and a structured execution_incident.
execution_hardening.final_response_rule: Execution mode may emit a terminal final response only after a fresh termination preflight returns ALLOW_FINAL_RESPONSE. Open PR, active current-head validation, or merged-with-closeout-pending is independently nonterminal even if a pending-step list was accidentally incomplete.

external_tool_access.fallback_rule: If a required external development tool is unavailable, expired, trial-limited, or no longer supports the intended AI/development workflow, replace it with a currently verified local/open-source or owner-approved durable alternative before governed start. Do not silently assume access.

projection_rule: Any copied validator/checkpoint/preflight values are generated or checkable projections of this profile and must not become independent authority.
